questions.question: Who is credited with inventing the telephone in 1876?
questions.hint: He was born in Scotland and conducted his famous experiment with Watson.

questions.question: The World Wide Web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee.
questions.hint: He proposed it in 1989 while working at CERN.

questions.question: What did Marie Curie discover that earned her a Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903?
questions.hint: Her work involved uranium and polonium.

questions.question: What name is given to the printing method invented by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440?
questions.hint: It involved individual letter blocks that could be rearranged.

questions.question: Thomas Edison invented the first practical light bulb in 1879.
Which country did Nikola Tesla emigrate to in 1884 to further his electrical research?
questions.hint: He eventually worked directly with Thomas Edison after arriving.

questions.question: What material did John Pemberton originally market his 1886 invention — later known as Coca-Cola — as?
questions.hint: It was originally sold at pharmacies, not restaurants.
